title: NRI Investments
shortText: Invest in Indian mutual funds from abroad through NRE / NRO accounts.
whatItIs: Non-resident Indians can invest in most Indian mutual fund schemes through NRE or NRO bank accounts after completing KYC with their overseas address. Some AMCs have restrictions for investors resident in the USA and Canada. Repatriation and taxation depend on the account used and applicable laws.
whoItSuits: Non-resident Indians who want to invest in India for long-term goals or for family needs in India.
howItWorks: Complete KYC with passport, overseas address proof and PAN
Choose AMCs and schemes that accept investments from your country of residence
Invest by SIP or lump sum from your NRE / NRO account
Track your holdings online from anywhere

faqs.question: Can NRIs in the USA invest?
faqs.answer: Only some AMCs accept investments from residents of the USA and Canada, usually with additional declarations.

faqs.question: Is tax deducted on redemption?
faqs.answer: Yes, tax is deducted at source on capital gains for NRIs as per applicable rates; consult a tax adviser.
